mom.title: Specimen Procurement Review
mom.summary: The Specimen Procurement Review was held to take stock of the revised procurement guidelines, the delayed server refresh, the stationery contract and vendor performance.
key_points: The Ministry has issued revised procurement guidelines, effective from the next financial year.
Every purchase above five lakh rupees now requires competitive bidding with at least three qualified vendors.
The server refresh has slipped by six weeks because two of the three shortlisted vendors withdrew.
The annual stationery contract expires in November.
Two vendors were rated below threshold in the performance report.
decisions: The server tender will be re-floated with a wider eligibility band.
The existing stationery contract will be extended by three months rather than rushing a fresh tender.

action_items.task: Re-float the server tender with a wider eligibility band
Extend the stationery contract by three months
Issue show-cause notices to the two underperforming vendors

key_figures: Competitive bidding threshold: five lakh rupees
